scope: Windows filesystem-only controls using the repository directory and the two DirectWrite probe fixtures. No engine or DirectWrite process was started by the control.

initialObservation.operation: CopyFileW replacing seven invalid bytes with a fixture
initialObservation.limit: The first run terminated on the copy exception before writing its per-round results. It did not capture the PID at failure.

mappedView.method: A child mapped the seven bytes read-only and closed its reader and section handles. The parent tested exclusive open and fixture replacement while the view existed, then repeated the copy after unmapping.

reader.method: Sample file users before opening the child reader, during its lifetime immediately after the failed exclusive open, and after closing it.

followup.method: Two runs of up to 250 replacements, requesting exclusive opens at offsets of 0, 1, 4 and 8 ms from each copy. File-user queries bracket every attempt. Offsets are requested minimum delays, not measured sampling times.

interpretation: An overwrite can fail with a mapped-file error in the same directory without the engine running. A mapped view alone sufficed for error 1224 in the control and still allowed exclusive open. The historical error 32 occurred on exclusive open; its owner remains unknown.
